name: The Missing Tickets
source:
After having lost some baseball tickets at a party, Jasper and Augustus investigate some friends to see who could have had the incentive to get them. In the meantime, time is running out as the game is about to start. 

[From[url=http://www.renai.us/game/mistickets.shtml] Ren'Ai Archive[/url]]
